_doc: Production standards: the one numbers file every production skill, reviewer and the generation gate read. Prose and reasons: STANDARDS.md (same folder). Change a number here and in STANDARDS.md together, with a dated line in STANDARDS.md's changelog.

gate_policy.budget_scope: A G-BUDGET PASS from the last 24 h before every gated generation (the first one at step 4 for voiced pieces, before step 7 on a LIB run). A video call also needs step 9 closed with a G-BUDGET recorded after the steps before it closed (the whole video re-priced).
gate_policy.edit_pass: An image asset's own previous version (same asset id, registered with an id, any gate status) may be the single image reference, registered with role edit_source and passed in the call as image_references (or image). The new version gets its own full review (VISUAL-QA 5.5 route 1).

storyboard.note: Every storyboard is image 1 in its H3 call, so every storyboard is hero (VISUAL-QA 5.3 'storyboard image 1'): zero defects.

motion_render.note: G-MOTION-TEXT (fresh prompt-reviewer: the code's text constants against the spec and the released script, VISUAL-QA 7.2) on the same version before any render is reviewed at G-MOTION-FRAMES.

voice.note: G-AUDIO: per audio asset, the take check (transcript against the script, take score) PASS. Needed before the asset is used as a reference and before step 11 (G-ASSETS) closes.

audio_slice.note: G-AUDIO: per audio asset, the take check (transcript against the script, take score) PASS. Needed before the asset is used as a reference and before step 11 (G-ASSETS) closes.

song.note: G-AUDIO: per audio asset, the take check (transcript against the script, take score) PASS. Needed before the asset is used as a reference and before step 11 (G-ASSETS) closes.

music.note: G-AUDIO: per audio asset, the take check (transcript against the script, take score) PASS. Needed before the asset is used as a reference and before step 11 (G-ASSETS) closes.

sfx.note: G-AUDIO: per audio asset, the take check (transcript against the script, take score) PASS. Needed before the asset is used as a reference and before step 11 (G-ASSETS) closes.

final.note: G-FINAL on the cut; also recorded as the run gate.

gpt_image_2_5.note: Carousels, statics, the style reference, and stills or start frames with no person in the client's style. Pass aspect_ratio 4:5 for feed, resolution 2k, quality medium (high only to polish an approved cover), variant flare. Faces of realistic people in reels: gpt_image_2. Stylized sheets and storyboards only inside the R1 test (G-HUMAN-TEST).

gpt_image_2.note: Realistic people, always with a reference photo (hub G7). No 4:5 output: a feed slide with a photoreal person is made in gpt_image_2_5 with the person's approved gpt_image_2 still as a reference (STANDARDS 1). The 3:4 fallback for such a slide needs a G-EXCEPTION (model gpt_image_2) on the asset.

nano_banana_2.note: Stylized sheets and storyboards (animation, song, clay, crochet). Pending the side-by-side test against gpt_image_2_5 (STANDARDS.md R1).

kling3_0.note: Silent start-to-end transformation only, after an H3 keyframe take failed the frame check (hub G2).

elevenlabs.note: ElevenLabs image and video models are not on the list: images come from Higgsfield (G7), video from H3 (G1). A drama X5 model needs G-EXCEPTION on the asset.
elevenlabs.song_notes: Songs: eleven_music_v2_5 with the released lyrics as custom lyrics, run as a flow node; read creative_get_model_schema for the lyrics and length fields first; never repeat a call to retry.

higgs_audio.note: Higgsfield speech is retired for our content (hub G8): voices, music and SFX come from ElevenLabs.

families._doc: Which pipeline steps (AI-VIDEO-PIPELINE.md section 1) apply to which production family. Formats in config/organic.json name their family in 'production'.

still.note: Single images and carousels: step 3 is the slide copy, step 10 the slide generation, step 11 G-VIS-SLIDE, step 13 G-SET.

motion.note: Code-rendered reels (HyperFrames): step 8 = G-MOTION-TEXT on the code's text constants, then preview frames and the hook styleframe; step 10 = render; step 11 = G-MOTION-FRAMES.

keyframe_reel.note: Tier C quote reel: one silent H3 keyframe shot from a passed start frame, voice and captions in the edit. No storyboard: one shot, no mouth. Step 4 needs G-HUMAN-VOICE until the narrator's record exists (per voice).

ai_video.note: Talking head, UGC, narrated story, animation, song, podcast, drama: every step.

real.note: Real footage (the owner films): no look bible, storyboard, credits or generation; steps 11 to 13 still check the takes, words and final cut.

song.note: Song pieces (format reel_song): every step; step 4 adds G-HUMAN-SONG, the owner's listen to every song master before any picture. A format may also name this family in organic.json 'production'.

G-HUMAN-SPINE.what: Pick the script spine and the master hook stack (Script Lab 12C). The owner said to run without stopping, so Claude picks, says which and why, and it shows in the queue as FYI.

G-HUMAN-VOICE.what: Listen once when a voice is cast for a client or series (audition and 15 s pilot); later spoken pieces with the locked voice pass on the measured take checks. For a non-English voice the note records the pace band measured on the approved audition (STANDARDS 4).

G-HUMAN-SONG.what: The owner listens to every song master before any picture is made (per piece): words, brand and keyword pronunciation, a slow hook. Sung Albanian can't be fully measured by Whisper.

G-HUMAN-LOOK.what: Approve the look bible (style, character, set and prop sheets) once per client or series; recorded on the client's LIB run.

G-HUMAN-HOOKBOARD.what: Hook storyboards always go to the owner (VISUAL-QA 6). Drama: the animatic and the cost preflight ride with the hook board. Podcast: the line-1 speaker's start frame with the title bar. Motion: the hook styleframe (the first 2 s at phone size with the text hook).

G-HUMAN-ESCALATE.what: An asset that failed 3 attempts (VISUAL-QA 5.5, 7.1): the best version and its report. Or a script (speech or lyrics) that failed 3 FIX loops with new readers (STANDARDS 9 G-SCRIPT): the best draft and its reports. A prompt that failed 2 review loops goes to the Organic Director first, who may send it here.

G-HUMAN-FINAL.what: Approval on the hub's Content page; nothing posts without it. Every Albanian string (script, lyrics, supers, captions, slides, caption text) is marked for a native read in the hub notes.

G-HUMAN-TEST.what: A test generation outside a post (a model re-test), with its reason.

G-FALLBACK.what: Kling 3.0 fallback for one shot after an H3 frame-check fail.

G-EXCEPTION.what: A model outside the standards for one asset (drama exception X5 routing). X6 to X10 need no G-EXCEPTION.

clips.duration_rule_interim: slice 4 to 14 s; duration = ceil(slice) + 1, within 5..15; the +1 s comes on top of any tail already in the file (re-test R2)
clips.podcast_stem_words_note: proposed, confirm on first run: (14 s minus about 2 s of beats and 1 s of tail) x 2.5 words/s; Script Lab's 30 to 35 is the ceiling

audio.storyteller_band_other_languages: measured on the approved audition, written in the voice's G-HUMAN-VOICE note
audio.song_whisper_match_note: proposed floor (the low end of the 0.88 to 0.95 band seen in our runs), confirm on the first run

lyrics_lines.O30_note: proposed (scaled from the 40 to 50 s row), check on the first run

picture.conform: repeat frames (ffmpeg fps=30), never interpolate a dialogue shot

placements.reel_file: MP4 H.264 + AAC, under 100 MB, 3 to 90 s

ai_label.stylized_animation: on per STANDARDS 7 (D1 decides whether to extend it)
ai_label.ai_people_interim: AI people are only shown from behind or as clearly staged scenes; no AI person is presented as a real client.

lengths._doc: STANDARDS.md section 8 is the single source for lengths; other docs point there.

open.H1: human listens reduced to G-HUMAN-VOICE per voice and G-HUMAN-SONG per song (owner may restore the four listens)

G-MOTION-TEXT.what: The code's text constants, layout positions, timing table and brand colours against the Shot Spec and the released script, before any render (VISUAL-QA 7.2).
